spec.claim_summary: A long DCA system enters when 4h RSI(14) drops below 28, adds five averaging orders down to -25% with scaling, and exits 3% above average entry with no stop.
spec.untestable_reason: The core is a five-rung DCA averaging ladder with 1.8x size scaling and take-profit on average entry, which cannot be expressed as a single-entry rule.
assumptions: Assets set to BTCUSDT from page context about BTC; claim text itself names no symbol.
Direction set to long because averaging down at negative deviations and taking profit above average entry implies long buys.
Entry compiled as RSI(14) crosses_below 28 on 4h closes from 'drops below 28'.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: five averaging/DCA orders at -2%, -5%, -9.5%, -16% and -25% with 1.8x size scaling per rung and 3% take-profit above average entry price; schema has no averaged entry or ladder fills.
Stop Loss: None per claim; ladder allocation described as structural risk cap, so no price stop encoded.
Test period and performance figures stored in claimed; engine tests all history starting flat.
